text: dsh-legal-dashboard 是面向 DSH Web 的法律项目工作台。它在侧边栏提供案件面板，并注册项目扫描、文档检索、案件分类、期限候选识别、文书处理和 OCR 工具。用户可浏览工作区文件、按关键词搜索材料、建立 DOCX/PDF 文本索引、查看案件清单并生成 DOCX 或 PDF 工作文稿。适合律师在单个项目文件夹中整理材料、核对事项并准备文书。OCR 需另行配置兼容服务；页面发送前会请求明确批准。

dsh-legal-dashboard adds a legal workspace to DSH Web. Its tools browse and search case files, classify matters, index DOCX/PDF text, find date candidates, and create documents. Lawyers can organize materials and prepare drafts. OCR uses a configured provider and asks before sending pages.

Help me turn scanned case PDFs into page-organized text for review.
dsh-legal-dashboard 的功能「案件概览与期限候选」：扫描当前工作区并汇总文件类别、材料清单和日期候选。调用案件工作台工具或打开概览面板即可查看；日期仅作为待核候选呈现。
dsh-legal-dashboard 的功能「案件文件搜索与索引」：按关键词搜索工作区文件名和可读文本，也可建立 DOCX/PDF 文本索引后检索内容。用户通过面板搜索或调用项目搜索、索引构建与索引搜索工具触发。
dsh-legal-dashboard 的功能「文书创建与修改」：根据标题和文本生成 DOCX 或 PDF，也可按精确文本替换生成修订版 DOCX。通过文书创建或编辑工具提交工作区相对路径和内容；创建输出要求为新文件。
dsh-legal-dashboard 的功能「扫描件 OCR」：把 PDF 或图片整理成页图并交给用户配置的兼容多模态服务识别，再将按页 Markdown 写回工作区。通过 OCR 工具触发，已缓存且仍匹配源文件的结果可复用。
dsh-legal-dashboard 使用前须知：OCR 会将所选文档渲染页发送至单独配置的外部多模态服务；服务地址和模型未配置时 OCR 不可用，发送前会请求明确批准。

需要按项目材料快速生成一份新的 DOCX 或 PDF 工作文稿。

A matter-aware legal workspace for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It turns each Harness workspace into a focused environment for litigation, arbitration, investigations, contract review, due diligence, advisory work, and other legal matters.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · DSH Legal Dashboard：> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is a community plugin for the DeepSeek Harness developer preview. Version `0.2.x` has been tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. It uses rc7's `shell.overlay` surface so the matter workspace, document preview, and native tool details can coexist.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Highlights：- **Matter workspace:** a right-side panel for overview, files, tasks, and matter-specific settings without covering the conversation area.
- **Legal file intelligence:** recursive file tree, folder collapsing, search, DOCX/PDF text indexing, and PDF classification as text, scanned, mixed, or unknown.
- **Document preview:** PDF, image, plain-text, and extracted DOCX previews inside the workspace.
- **Matter-aware checklist:** automatic or manual matter classification with checklists for litigation, arbitration, criminal, administrative, complaint, contract review, due diligence, advisory, and special non-contentious work.
- **Legal document operations:** create DOCX/PDF deliverables, extract text, revise DOCX files, and save new versions without silently overwriting originals.
- **OCR workflow:** prepare scanned PDFs and images, request explicit approval before external transmission, call an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and persist reviewed Markdown results.
- **Native Harness tasks:** create long-term goals through `/goal` and display live goals and todos in the Tasks tab.
- **Adaptive bilingual UI:** all plugin UI follows the Harness `C

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Installation：Install the plugin into the standard Web profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:ByronLeeeee/dsh-legal-dashboard#main"
dsh web
```

For a reproducible installation, replace `main` with a trusted commit SHA:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:ByronLeeeee/dsh-legal-dashboard#<commit-sha>"
```

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Installation：Only install Git dependencies whose source you trust. See the Harness guide on [packaging and installing plugins](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md).

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-legal-dashboard
```

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Getting started：1. Run `dsh web` and open `http://localhost:3080/`.
2. Select **Add workspace** and choose the folder containing the matter files.
3. Select the workspace and click **Matter** in the left sidebar.
4. Use **Overview** for the checklist and quick actions, **Files** for search and preview, **Tasks** for goals and todos, and **Settings** for matter type and OCR configuration.

Example prompts:

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Getting started：```text
Review all matter files and identify disputed issues and missing evidence.
Prepare an evidence index with the source and purpose of proof for each item.
Draft a statement of claim and save it as Work Product/Statement of Claim.docx.
Run OCR on Evidence/Chat Records.pdf and save the reviewed result as Markdown.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · OCR configuration：The main conversation can continue to use DeepSeek. OCR uses a separate OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint. Open **Matter → Settings → OCR** and configure:

- Base URL, such as `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- An image-capable model name
- API key
- Maximum pages, output tokens, and timeout

The API key is stored through the Harness credential service or read from `DSH_LEGAL_OCR_API_KEY`; it should not be committed to YAML. Leaving the Base URL or model empty disables external OCR.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · OCR configuration：Before external OCR sends any page image, Harness asks for explicit approval. OCR results are cached against the source file signature and reused only while current.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Security model：- Every file operation resolves from the active Agent session's workspace.
- Absolute paths, path traversal, symbolic links, non-regular files, and access outside the registered workspace are rejected.
- Document operations create new files or revised copies by default and do not silently overwrite source documents.
- Local indexes are written to `.legal-index`; temporary OCR pages are written to `.legal-ocr`.
- External OCR is optional, requires configuration, and passes through an approval boundary before file content leaves the machine.
- Generated analysis and documents require professional review before use or delivery.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Windows launcher：Windows users may run [`desktop/启动律师工作台.cmd`](desktop/%E5%90%AF%E5%8A%A8%E5%BE%8B%E5%B8%88%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C%E5%8F%B0.cmd). The launcher reuses an existing service on port 3080 or starts its own hidden Harness process and opens an Edge app window. It only stops a service that it started itself.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Development and verification：Install dependencies and run the host-side syntax and behavior checks:

```powershell
npm ci
npm run check
```

The current suite covers workspace containment, file walking and search, document operations, PDF/OCR workflows, matter profiling, and Harness tool registration. The prebuilt Web client is committed under `lib/` for GitHub installation.

dsh-legal-dashboard README · Project status：This project follows the rapid development of DeepSeek Harness. Compatibility fixes and narrowly scoped contributions are welcome through [issues](https://github.com/ByronLeeeee/dsh-legal-dashboard/issues) and pull requests.
